newsitem.title: UK: Europe mill demand is for July cotton, and later.
newsitem.headline: Europe mill demand is for July cotton, and later.

text.p: Mill demand in most Euorpean importing markets again focused on July and later shipment periods.
Central Asian styles are sought in this regard by mills in Germany but sellers are restricted in what they are willing to offer and the volume of business in progress seems relatively small.

Some market reports mention further interest in West African descriptions. Further ahead, some spinners showed a moderate interest in booking winter shipment supplies but overall business for this period is also limited.
